subject: register-35-36-37-car-r1
abstract: Two commits landed on car/register-35-36-37. Commit cf026db (#35, #36): tightened register-css.test.js to (a) strip block comments before rule-block extraction so a brace inside a comment cannot truncate it, and (b) assert that declared color is neither inherit nor currentColor - all three reviewer attacks (inherit, currentColor, commented-out declaration) now RED; added color:var(--text) to .track-title and a new .declared-not-observed CSS rule pinned structurally to var(--needs-attention); web suite 59 to 61. Commit 451e6d1 (#37): created board/web/test/register-taxonomy.test.js (REGISTER_ORDER vs schema enum, set-equality, ordering-is-compose.js-owned comment) and board/assemble/register_taxonomy_test.go (closedRegisters vs schema enum via repoRoot helper), both with fault-injection evidence confirming non-vacuity; web suite 61 to 62, all 5 Go packages pass, gofmt clean.
